all_bills.script: (() => { return (async () => { const KEY = '@user-data'; const KEYCLOAK_URL = 'https://seguranca.medsenior.com.br/auth'; const REALM = 'MilSeniorProd'; const CLIENT_ID = 'portalcliente-web'; const BASE_API = 'https://portaldocliente-api.cloud.medsenior.com.br'; const PORTAL_WEB_ORIGIN = 'D86A23C6-2FD6-40A1-9568-650982AC33FE'; const injectedContext = window.__codexTemplateContext || {}; const injectedCredentials = injectedContext.credentials || {}; const normalizeMonth = (value) => { const match = String(value || '').match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/); return match ? `${match[2]}-${match[1]}` : ''; }; const normalizeDueDate = (value) => { if (!value) return ''; const raw = String(value).trim(); const ddmmyyyy = raw.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/); if (ddmmyyyy) return raw; const iso = raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/); return iso ? `${iso[3]}/${iso[2]}/${iso[1]}` : raw; }; const normalizeAmount = (value) => { if (typeof value === 'number') return value.toFixed(2); const raw = String(value || '').trim(); if (!raw) return ''; const normalized = raw.includes(',') && raw.includes('.') ? raw.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.') : raw.includes(',') ? raw.replace(',', '.') : raw; const parsed = Number(normalized); return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed.toFixed(2) : raw; }; const normalizeBarcode = (value) => { const digits = String(value || '').replace(/\D/g, ''); return digits.length >= 44 ? digits : ''; }; const isPaidStatus = (value) => /baixad|pago|quitad|liquidad/i.test(String(value || '')); const getStoredToken = () => { const rawUser = localStorage.getItem(KEY); if (!rawUser) return ''; try { return JSON.parse(rawUser)?.access_token || ''; } catch { return ''; } }; const fetchPasswordGrantToken = async () => { const username = String(injectedCredentials.username || injectedCredentials.email || '').replace(/\D/g, ''); const password = String(injectedCredentials.password || ''); if (!username || !password) return ''; const body = new URLSearchParams({ client_id: CLIENT_ID, grant_type: 'password', username, password }); const response = await fetch(`${KEYCLOAK_URL}/realms/${REALM}/protocol/openid-connect/token`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: body.toString() }); if (!response.ok) return ''; try { return (await response.json())?.access_token || ''; } catch { return ''; } }; let token = getStoredToken(); if (!token) token = await fetchPasswordGrantToken(); if (!token) { window.__codexMedseniorBills = []; window.__codexMedseniorPrimary = null; return JSON.stringify([]); } const listRes = await fetch(`${BASE_API}/api/v1/beneficiarios/buscar/segunda-via/boletos`, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }); if (!listRes.ok) throw new Error(`Medsenior list failed: ${listRes.status}`); const listJson = await listRes.json(); const rows = Array.isArray(listJson) ? listJson : Array.isArray(listJson?.data) ? listJson.data : []; await Promise.allSettled(rows.filter((row) => row?.nossoNumero && !isPaidStatus(row?.status)).map((row) => fetch(`${BASE_API}/api/v1/beneficiarios/boletos/copiar-codigo-barras/${row.nossoNumero}/${PORTAL_WEB_ORIGIN}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }))); const bills = rows.map((row) => ({ bill_id: row?.nossoNumero ? String(row.nossoNumero) : row?.id ? String(row.id) : '', reference_month: normalizeMonth(row?.mensalidade), due_date: normalizeDueDate(row?.dataVencimentoProrrogado || row?.dataVencimento), amount: normalizeAmount(row?.valorDocumento), status: String(row?.status || '').trim(), barcode: normalizeBarcode(row?.linhaDigitavel || row?.codigoBarras), issuer: String(row?.razaoSocialOperadora || row?.beneficiario || row?.nomeBeneficiario || 'Medsenior / Samedil'), nosso_numero: row?.nossoNumero ? String(row.nossoNumero) : '', linha_digitavel_raw: String(row?.linhaDigitavel || ''), codigo_barras_raw: String(row?.codigoBarras || '') })).filter((row) => row.reference_month && row.amount).sort((a, b) => { const left = a.due_date.split('/').reverse().join('-') || a.reference_month; const right = b.due_date.split('/').reverse().join('-') || b.reference_month; return left.localeCompare(right); }); const primaryPending = bills.find((row) => !isPaidStatus(row.status)) || null; const primaryFallback = primaryPending || bills[0] || null; window.__codexMedseniorBills = bills; window.__codexMedseniorPrimary = primaryFallback; return JSON.stringify(bills); })(); })()

notes: Portal Medsenior nao oferece pagamento automatico por cartao neste fluxo
O playbook coleta boletos e cria notificacao com linha digitavel para pagamento manual
A extracao usa o token salvo em localStorage @user-data apos o login Keycloak
A rotina tambem chama o endpoint copiar-codigo-barras por boleto como melhor esforco
Login Keycloak com campos estaveis #username, #password e botao #kc-login
A lista de boletos ja retorna linhaDigitavel/codigoBarras na maioria dos casos
